messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into French, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE French line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
De cette humble Italie sera le salut pour laquelle mourut la vierge Camilla, Eurialos et Turnus et Nisus blessés.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.
